finding: The Freeze parameter is persisted by StateStore, but the frozen Beads runtime buffers are not part of the processor-owned payload.
reason: Beads::Synth exposes Init, Reset, and Render; its delay lines, grains, envelopes, and reverb state are private and have no snapshot/restore API. A complete frozen-buffer recall therefore requires an upstream Beads serialization seam or a product-local replacement sampler.
